Scenario fixture: label-for-valid

Each target has a stable id of the form lfv_case_NN.

A. The label names a labelable element

01 — PASS: for names an input
02 — PASS: for names a select
03 — PASS: for names a custom element, which may be form-associated

B. The label labels nothing (CANTTELL)

04 — CANTTELL: for names no element (LABEL_FOR_TARGET_MISSING)
05 — CANTTELL: for names a div (LABEL_FOR_NOT_LABELABLE)
06 — CANTTELL: for names a hidden input (LABEL_FOR_NOT_LABELABLE)

C. Left out (no occurrence)

07 — NEUTRAL: a label with no for, wrapping its control
08 — NEUTRAL: a hidden label
